headline: Bitcoin fell below $56,000 on Saturday, its lowest price since September 2024, as a sell-off that started in AI stocks spread across crypto.

market.asOf: Read by this desk from CoinMarketCap at about 07:56-07:58 UTC Sat 21 Nov (14:56-14:58 Bangkok). Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Two indexes, both in extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index showed 12 out of 100 ("Extreme Fear", 10 the day before), and CoinMarketCap's own index showed 8 out of 100, both read at about 07:58 UTC Sat.

stories.title: Bitcoin falls below $56,000, its lowest price since September 2024
stories.summary: The sell-off kept going overnight. Bitcoin broke below its summer low and dropped under $56,000 early Saturday, about 18% lower than a week ago, before bouncing back toward $58,000. Traders who borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out, and money kept leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: Bitcoin hit a low of $55,130 on Binance and is down about 18% from roughly $68,250 on 14 Nov, per crypto.news; Investing.com had it at $55,789, down 9.89%, at 05:56 GMT Saturday.
About $2.40 billion of crypto futures bets were wiped out in 24 hours, more than $1 billion of them on bitcoin and $545 million on ether, per CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk.

US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $582.2 million on Thursday 19 Nov, $541.1 million of it from BlackRock's IBIT, and November's outflows are near $3.5 billion, per The Block. Friday's figure was not confirmed when this was written.
Bitcoin is down 28% this quarter and well below its October 2025 peak above $126,000, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: crypto.news: bitcoin breaks its summer low
CoinDesk: bitcoin at a two-year low

stories.title: The sell-off spreads: ether drops below $1,600 and XRP hits a two-year low
stories.summary: This is no longer only a bitcoin drop. Ether, XRP, Solana and smaller coins all fell hard. In a broad sell-off, smaller and riskier coins usually fall further than bitcoin.
points: XRP fell about 9% in 24 hours to about 87 cents, its lowest level since November 2024, per CoinDesk; the article says ether lost more than 10% and Solana more than 9%.
Ether dropped as low as $1,581.47 on Binance and $1,578.78 on Coinbase on Friday, per CoinTurk News.
The five US spot XRP ETFs now hold about $990 million after a $4.97 million outflow on Friday, per CoinDesk.
US spot ether ETFs lost $131.2 million on Thursday 19 Nov, per The Block.

stories.title: AI stock rout: Nvidia drops 14% and the main Dow fund has its worst week since March 2020
stories.summary: US stocks fell hard on Friday, led by chipmaker Nvidia and other AI-related stocks, while bitcoin weakened at the same time. US stock markets are closed for the weekend, so these are Friday's closing numbers.
points: Nvidia closed at $125.53, down 14.01%; AMD fell 13.25% and Broadcom 12.19%, per StockTitan.
The Nasdaq fell 5.3% to 22,617.73, the S&P 500 3.7% to 6,910.39 and the Dow 1.9% to 48,147.33, leaving all three more than 10% below their record highs, per Bitcoin.com News.
The main Dow-tracking fund (DIA) ended the week about 8% lower, its biggest weekly drop since the week ending 20 March 2020, per StockTitan.
Markets expect the Fed to raise interest rates at its 8-9 December meeting: CME FedWatch put the odds of a quarter-point hike at 95.4% on 18 Nov, per EconoTimes.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: stocks and crypto battered

briefs.title: Strategy's bitcoin is now worth less than it paid
briefs.summary: Strategy's average purchase price is about $75,446 per bitcoin on roughly 848,517 BTC (holdings as of 25 Oct), well above today's price, per Coinpaper.

briefs.title: Binance hackers move about $860 million in ether
briefs.summary: Elliptic says about 488,000 ETH left five of the nine largest ether wallets tied to the hack from 17 to 20 Nov, and at least 2,310 BTC, about $149 million, has gone through mixers so far in November, per Bitcoin.com News.

briefs.title: Senate passes a prediction-market bill
briefs.summary: The DEATH BETS Act passed the Senate by voice vote on 19 Nov and still needs the House, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: SEC freezes assets in alleged $560 million scheme
briefs.summary: The SEC won an emergency asset freeze in an alleged $560 million scheme tied to Backward Hat Capital, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent buys Tribe Capital
briefs.summary: Payward will buy Tribe Capital, which manages $2.7 billion; the price was not disclosed and the deal is expected to close in Q1 2027, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: JPMorgan: bitcoin trades far below its mining cost
briefs.summary: JPMorgan estimates it costs about $86,000 to produce one bitcoin and says "some capital has also left the crypto market altogether," per The Block.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (second estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: PCE and Q3 GDP are both due at 8:30am ET, per the BEA schedule. Forecasts cited by Newsquawk: core PCE 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%), headline PCE 3.8% (prior 3.6%); there was no formal consensus poll as of 18 Nov, per Admiral Markets. Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% against the 3.4% first estimate, per Trading Economics. Durable goods forecast +0.5% (prior +1.9%), per Trading Economics. Jobless claims move up a day for Thanksgiving; last week's were 203K, per Newsquawk.
The Fed's survey of business conditions around the country, per the Fed's calendar. October new home sales come out earlier the same day at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok), per the Census Bureau.
On Friday 27 Nov US stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE. Crypto trades all day, but thin trading can mean bigger swings.

TokenPost puts the bitcoin options expiry at about $6.67 billion across 105,053 contracts with the "max pain" level at $74,000; a Substack newsletter citing KCEX puts it at $6.5 billion with max pain at $75,000 (both read 20 Nov).
Fed officials stop public comment on policy from 28 Nov until 10 Dec, per the Fed's blackout calendar.
The last jobs report before the Fed decision, per the BLS schedule. JOLTS job openings come out Tue 1 Dec at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok); November CPI is Thu 10 Dec, the day after the Fed.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision at 2:00pm ET Wed 9 Dec (02:00 Thu Bangkok), press conference 2:30pm, per the Fed's December calendar. The current range is 3.75-4.00%, held in October on a 10-2 vote, per the Fed. Markets expect a hike; see the stock story above for the odds.
